annotations.title: Payment plan: which rail to pay a verified payee on

description: Plan a payment to a payee before paying it: from its verified record (company, sanctions, signed wallets) and the rails it accepts (x402 USDC, MPP, card checkout, SEPA Instant, Swish), the best rail for the amount and currency and exactly what to pay where, plus finality, chargebacks and how to get a receipt. Never pays, routes or holds money. Use before paying when the buyer can pay several ways. Example: domain=agent-data-tools.revmesh2074.workers.dev. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 10 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

amount.description: Amount to pay, in currency (optional; used for rail minimums)

can.description: Rails the buyer can pay on, comma-separated: x402, mpp, card, sepa-instant, swish (default all)

currency.description: ISO currency of the price: USD (default), EUR, SEK… USDC counts as USD

network.description: Only x402 rails on this network, e.g. base
